scope: Only arbitrary-distribution inlet selection; independent fresh instance of original analytic/simpleCX/all-elastic-off slab. Not combined with conditionB.

boundary.relative_amplitude_units: dimensionless arbitrary normalization; density is fixed after transfer to generated dimensionless velocity grid
boundary.simple_component_inputs: All absent; no energies_eV,velocities_ms or fractions supplied in this arbitrary mode
boundary.flux_semantics: No independent upper-level desired_flux parameter. After density normalization derive G from the positive-vx discrete moment; then pass that G to the unchanged lower flux-authoritative normalization.

mesh_added_energy_recipe: E0=[0.5*mu*mH*min(axial_axis_m_s-1[axial_axis_m_s-1>0])^2/Q]; no value evaluated. Use this same E0 in both original mesh construction stages. Empty configured extras add nothing.
selection_basis: Literal finite positive author-selected axes/amplitudes for an ordinary input condition; not fitted to hidden outputs,generated solver grids,prior answers or scientific evaluation.
